I had a really good experience at DC Dental Clinic. From my first inquiry up to my recent visits, the staff have been very accommodating and kind. They explain the procedures clearly, which helped ease my worries, especially since I was very nervous about my extractions.

The orthodontist is professional and patient, making sure I was comfortable during every step of my braces journey. Even though I had four teeth removed, they handled it well and guided me on what to expect and how to take care of myself after.

The clinic is clean, organized, and the overall service is worth the cost. I truly appreciate how they take care of their patients. I would definitely recommend DC Dental Clinic to anyone planning to get braces or dental treatment.

Exceptional experience. I had my veneers done here, and the level of artistry is outstanding. The dentist is highly skilled and meticulous, while the staff ensures you feel comfortable throughout every visit. It’s hard to find this kind of premium cosmetic dental care at such an honest price point. Highly recommended if you’re looking to upgrade your smile.😁

Hi, everyone
I came here just to fix my broken tooth . It was my first time I didn't use the anesthetic .! The dentist was so gentle ,calm and kind so that I decided to have my teeth checked, cleaned and also whitened.
Everything was complete nicely within 2 hours.
The clinic was awesome impressive clean as shown in the pictures.
The atmosphere and staff were excellent and  friendly.
Moreover, the rate of service was reasonable happily.
Thank you for your service 🙏.

I had an emergency dental situation while traveling, and the team at DC Dental Clinic was absolutely incredible. They were so kind and managed to fit me in for an appointment almost immediately to address my pain.  Dr. Duitreed Choradol is a lovely person and a true professional. She was incredibly gentle and took the time to explain every detail and step of the treatment, which really helped put me at ease. She was focused on alleviating my pain and handled the broken tooth with expert care.  Furthermore, the clinic was extremely helpful in providing all the necessary, detailed documentation I needed for my insurance reimbursement. The facility is spotless, and the staff speaks an excellent level of English.  Thank you so much, Dr. Duitreed, for your wonderful care! I highly recommend this clinic to anyone in Chiang Mai.
Best Dental Clinic In Heart Of Chiangmai. Affordable With Top Quality Dentist. Fully Equip Clinic. Highly Recommend. Did My X-Ray & Tooth Extraction Today. Very Happy Giving me a peace of mind

Came here for fillings, a cleaning, and to get my braces. The staff is super helpful and accommodating. The dentist is highly skilled, attentive, and very gentle. Prices are totally reasonable too. Really impressed with the overall experience. Highly recommend! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

The doctors & staff are very friendly and took great care of me during my visits. I came twice. First appointment: cleaning + whitening. Second appointment: Root canal + fillings. I get nervous when it comes to root canals but the doctor & the assistant made me feel at ease the entire time. They were thorough & gentle. Thank you DC Dental Chiang Mai ; ขอบคุณ 🙏🏾

I lived in Phuket, Thailand for almost 15 years, now retired and traveling here there and everywhere. This is one of the best dental clinic in Thailand.

Since my last teeth examination and cleaning in Bangkok about 1.5 years ago, I decided to check and clean my teeth while traveling in Chiang Mai. Based on google review, I went to another dental clinic to have my teeth cleaned and checked yesterday. Unfortunately, the experience was bad (may see my another review if interested).

So I had to search again and finally decided to come to this one. I told the dentist that in my previous visit to another clinic, I was informed that there might be decays in my teeth that need filling. She examined my teeth thoroughly and concluded that there isn't any problem. To ease my concern, she suggested making an X-ray examination which subsequently reaffirmed her conclusion.
Not only showing her professional and skillful dentistry, compared with the previous dentist trying to cheat me that there were 5 decays that need filling at a cost of 4,000 Bahts (800 Bahts each), the ethics of is dentist in DC Dental Clinic is definitely worth appraising.

I appreciate the work of doctor and her assistant team. We removed 4 wisdom teeth together. Everything was running smoothly. Doctor Boo is understanding what to do, highly experienced and smart lady. Very affordable prices.

I visited Chiangmai and had a crown fall out so I texted the clinic in late night. The next morning they kindly fit me in and fixed my crown before my flight. The doctor was so gentle and professional. Super grateful and I really recommend this clinic.

After researching several clinics, I finally decided on this one and I made the right choice. I recently had my teeth whitening with DC. My teeth are noticeably brighter. The shade is very natural, without any tooth sensitivity. Hightly recommend it!

Had to leave a 5 star review for a discount, which explains how they got the high rating.

Here’s my HONEST experience:

I received the typical foreigner treatment, triple the price for a poor and lazy job.

My asian girlfriend came to this clinic recently and paid 3000 baht for a bigger operation that took over an hour.

I went last week, didn’t get any x-ray. Walked in at 2.45pm, was all finished at 3.10pm. The whole process was very rushed and finished in less than 30 minutes.

The price for a sloppy 30-minute job? 8,500 baht (almost 300 dollars!)

Insane and unfair to discriminate prices and service based on race.

I found this clinic through Google reviews and made an appointment for a teeth cleaning, fillings, and some cosmetic works on my front teeth. The dentist had a keen understanding and skill in cosmetic dentistry, delivering exactly what I needed with minimal explanation. Everything is simple, convenient and attentive. Hightly recommend!

The dental care I received from Dr. Bo was excellent. I had some fillings and a crown done. She was very gentle and professional. I really appreciated how she listened when I asked for a slight adjustment. The staff were all friendly and made me feel at ease.

Very nice dental clinic !
Professional and patient dental advice!
Will visit again in the future.
Also got some free drinks after the treatment. Many thanks~ ^^

I came to Chiang Mai for a short stay and hoped to get a full dental makeover. They managed to complete everything 14 veneers and 2 crowns within my schedule. The team was super organized, and the dentist was very kind. No pain at all. I’m really satisfied with the result.

My 1st initial visit to DC Dental was based on recommendation from a guest at my condo who is visiting from UK. I asked for exam and cleaning since it had been 1-1/2 years since my last from my regular dentist in Pattaya.
My appointment was for 1p.m. I arrived at 12:50 with expectation of some paperwork to be filled out took about 2 min. I waited until 1:30 until dentist arrived, I do not mind waiting 5-10 minutes for appointments but 30 min. A bit much, regardless got into chair cleaned and polished in 15 min. Again my dentist minimum 30 min. Maybe because of late arrival she became backed up with clients who arrived while I was in chair. Just felt a bit rushed. As far as cleaning goes I unfortunately had motorcycle accident after leaving office, oil on road,and in hospital now with broken clavicle, so just finally had opportunity to look  teeth over more closely. I would say 9 out of 10 on cleaning,looks like maybe 1 or 2 places needed more attention maybe not? Since she did not explain if this is a good as it gets. 3.5 stars.

A no frills, no fuss dental clinic that gets the job done. I made an appointment the day before and they were able to slot me and my friend in. Cleaning took about 25 minutes and was thorough. They will tell you the price beforehand after looking at your teeth at the initial consultation. A fraction of what I would have paid back home... Very worth it!
Amazing clinic, they are very professional and affordable. Both of my visits have been perfect and I’m so happy with the results!

Clean and good atmosphere..
I did wisdom tooth extraction and the dentist is very good to take care of my pain.
I felt painful only for two days.
Highly recommended
